title: The first UI action the model owns, and the exact separation of acting from choosing
the_question: 'isn't instant learning enough to solve everything on a computer' + 'YOU SURE THIS THE SMARTEST APPROACH?' at every step

before_this_round.its_own_verification_receipt: ASTRA-VERIFY-BROWSER-INTERACTION-001 carries a recorded BLOCKER: SELECT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND
before_this_round.reading: the model believed it could click. its own evidence said it could not.

built.channels: CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent / dispatchKeyEvent only; method allowlist; expression allowlist; local URLs only (URL_NOT_LOCAL_BENCHMARK_PAGE)
built.measures: it does NOT choose the target. grounding is a separate capability and a separate measurement.

the_independent_oracle.who: MiniWob++ in-page grader -- WOB_DONE_GLOBAL / WOB_REWARD_GLOBAL -- written by strangers, read after the action
the_independent_oracle.why_it_qualifies: the capability returns the PAGE's verdict, never its own; self-report is refused exactly as the adapter refuses it elsewhere

measured.click-option, target 'Submit': actuated, done=True, reward=-1 -- correct refusal to claim a win
measured.click-button / click-dialog: TARGET_NOT_ON_PAGE -- the named target did not exist on the rendered page
measured.honest_reading: the ACTION works (the page accepted a real mouse event and graded it); the TARGET CHOICE is the failing part. That is precisely the split this round was built to expose.

two_defects_found_in_my_own_work: the actuator could not see pages whose #area renders empty until the first interaction -- three of four probes returned TARGET_NOT_ON_PAGE for a target that did not exist YET
my first probe used port 8893 /miniwob/ while the served root is /html/miniwob/ -- a 404 read as 'the page is empty'

state_of_the_model_now.deliverable_producers: xlsx, docx(declared), pdf (added r100), json, text
state_of_the_model_now.routing: 445 capabilities; 'click the button on the page' -> web.page.act.on_rendered_page, confident

what_this_does_to_the_users_thesis.unchanged: instant learning still compresses the Nth execution to zero and does nothing for the 1st
what_this_does_to_the_users_thesis.changed: the model now has a FIRST execution channel for computer use. r98 measured 0 of 444 UI actions; that is no longer zero.
what_this_does_to_the_users_thesis.the_next_limit_is_named_and_measured: ACTION EXISTS (1 verified), CHOICE DOES NOT (1 of 4 targets correct, and r93 measured 21/130 end-to-end). The binding constraint has moved from 'no actuator at all' to 'no target selection'.
what_this_does_to_the_users_thesis.why_that_matters_for_the_thesis: a demonstration can only be recorded once an action succeeds. This round created the recorder. It did not create the chooser.

smartest_next: 1. join web.page.act.on_rendered_page to page_first_grounding_v1 inside one loop and score it end-to-end on the 130-task suite (the r93 number was measured before any actuator was in the model)
2. the chooser is the whole remaining gap: grounding must pick the target AND the action
3. keep the independent-oracle bar: the page grades the page
